Type a customer's username into a box and press + to place them on that box.

Teams

Everyone entered

Click any name to rename it, and Delete removes just that one name. Nothing here clears the whole board.

Resetting

Every board has its own Reset. It clears only the boxes on that board — nothing else. On Teams that's the toolbar button. On Divisions the same. On Pick your Pairs there are two boards on the tab, so each one carries its own Reset Pick your Pairs and Reset Divisions button in its header — clear the pairs and the divisions stay, or the other way round.

A reset only asks once and always offers Undo afterwards. Hide all is the only button that clears every board at once, and it's undoable too.

Fixing a name

Click a name on the board — the little plaque inside a closed box — and a small editor opens right there. Change the spelling and hit Save, or Remove to take that one person off. In the list above, click any name to rename it, or use Delete on that row.

A taken box carries no wording at all: it simply goes grey, with the customer's name still lit up in gold.

Adding a board: open boards.js and add one entry to the list. The tab, the grid, the heading, the counter and the Reset button all build themselves from it.
